description: T12 (design doc §9): the board-overlay scripts take every colour from the UIConstants slots, or from its two neutral chrome backdrops (OVERLAY_LABEL_BG, OVERLAY_SHADOW, kept out of the slot table), instead of ad-hoc Color(...) literals; alphas are applied at draw time with UIConstants.with_alpha(). Scope: the nine Touches files (MovementRangeVisual with its DragRuler, EngagementRangeVisual, CoherencyCircleVisual, ChargeTrajectoryPreview, DeepStrikeExclusionVisual, DamageFeedbackVisual, ChargeArrowVisual, DeploymentZoneVisual, AIMovementPathVisual) plus the two twins that shared their literals (HumanMovementPathVisual, InfiltratorExclusionVisual). Fixture co_pretrigger (fight phase). Z (player path) shows both deployment zones; every overlay the eleven scripts draw is then put on the board through the public API its production caller uses (MovementRangeVisual.set_from, DragRuler.show_path, CoherencyCircleVisual.setup / set_in_range, ChargeTrajectoryPreview.update_trajectories, HumanMovementPathVisual.update_planning_paths, the Deep Strike / Infiltrator show_exclusion on GameState's enemy zone, ChargeArrowVisual.show_static / set_roll_result, AIMovementPathVisual.show_paths, DamageFeedbackVisual.play_*) and frozen on a fixed frame (process disabled, pulse / march phase 0, seeded RNG), so two builds render the same pixels (run-to-run diff 0.0% on every frame). Three fixture framings (engagement zoom x2 on Custodian Guard B in base contact with Warboss B; reserves zoom x1 on the P2 zone; full board, the load framing at zoom 0.3) are captured without and with the persistent overlays, then two effects frames add the transient ones (charge arrows, AI trails, damage feedback). Tier A: the class walk finds 42 Color constants / script variables, every one a slot or chrome; each semantic constant is in its slot (charge declared WARNING_ORANGE, success CONFIRMED_GREEN, failure INVALID_RED, P1 / P2 trails FRIENDLY_PLAYER_TEAL / ENEMY_PLAYER_MAGENTA, exclusions INVALID_RED, summary text NEUTRAL_UI_PALE_WHITE, ...); the shipped source of the eleven files has 0 `Color(` / named `Color.X` (101 lines before T12); the live damage labels and backdrops the production paths built are the slots; the failed-charge and declared arrowheads on the capture are exactly INVALID_RED / WARNING_ORANGE (pre-T12 #FF3333 / #FF9900). Each of those steps fails on the pre-T12 build. Pre- vs post-T12 diff of the same frames (pixel_diff_cli on captures from both builds, recorded in .llm/todo.md): engagement 0.38%, reserves 1.01%, full board 0.13%, all under the 2% bound; effects frames 3.52% (engagement, 1.86% of it the hit-flash disc frozen at its peak: #FF260D -> INVALID_RED, the nearest slot) and 1.21% (reserves). In-run bounds: each overlay frame differs from its overlay-free twin (> 5% / 5% / 1%) and each effects frame from its overlay frame (> 3% / 0.25%).
